title: Global Newland U-Shaped Desk - 72"W x 96"D
body_html:
A full U-shaped command desk that gives administrators a generous work surface, a locking pedestal, and the kind of build quality that outlasts a decade of institutional use.

The Global Newland NLP228 pairs a 30" x 72" main worktable with a 24" x 42" bridge and a 24" x 72" credenza, wrapping the user in nearly 96" of working depth. A 1" thermally fused laminate top with a 2 mm matching edge sits on 2" square metal legs with leveling glides, and a locking hanging box/file pedestal keeps documents secure. Built in Canada and reversible for left- or right-hand layouts, it ships in six cartons for quick on-site assembly.

Key features

  • Full U-shaped configuration: table desk, bridge and credenza with a hanging box/file pedestal
  • 1" thick thermally fused laminate top with 2 mm matching edge for institutional durability
  • 2" square metal legs with leveling glides keep the suite stable on uneven floors
  • Reversible build - assembles for left- or right-hand applications
  • Locking pedestal secures documents and personal belongings
  • Designed for quick and easy assembly

Who it’s for

Private offices for managers and administrators in municipal, education, and healthcare environments that need a full-size, storage-rich command desk.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
